title: Prepare a step-by-step plan for publishing QShopper in an app store
scope: Backlog item only. Define and prepare the publication steps when requested. This intake item does not authorize account creation, uploads, external submissions, or publication.
request: Prepare the app for app-store publication and define the steps needed to publish it.
expected: A practical release checklist and preparation plan with dependencies, required user decisions, acceptance criteria, and a clear path from the current development build to a store release.
planning_steps: Confirm the target store(s), developer account/identity, intended audience, supported countries/languages, and distribution or pricing decisions. Google Play is the likely Android target but remains to be confirmed.
Check the selected store's current official requirements at implementation time, recording sources and dates rather than treating this backlog as a fixed policy checklist.
Agree release readiness criteria and identify blocking bugs, missing behavior, and validation work from the existing backlog, including critical right-swipe behavior and comprehensive UI coverage.

Define a reproducible production Release build and required store artifact, including package identity, version name/code progression, SDK/ABI requirements, dependency packaging, and disabled development-only behavior.

Define production signing and key backup/ownership. Distinguish the current debug keystore from any required upload/app-signing keys and plan the transition from existing debug installations without assuming signing compatibility.

Test clean installation, updates, persistence, representative devices, native keyboard/Back gestures, safe areas, accessibility, and release-specific behavior using isolated test data where appropriate.

Audit permissions, data handling, backup behavior, third-party dependencies, and applicable licensing/privacy obligations; prepare the selected store's required declarations and supporting policy materials based on actual app behavior.
Prepare store-listing assets and text: app name/description, icon, screenshots and any other required imagery, category, support/contact information, and localization as applicable.
Define internal/closed testing and review/submission steps appropriate to the store/account, followed by user-approved production rollout and a monitoring/support plan.
Document release tagging/artifact retention, future update procedures, and what to do if a release needs to be halted or corrected.
implementation_notes: Keep the process KISS: a concise, repeatable checklist supported by necessary scripts, not an elaborate release framework.
Reuse ANDROID.md, build-android.ps1, the verification workflow, and existing tickets rather than duplicating build or bug-tracking instructions.
Record unknown account-specific requirements and user decisions explicitly instead of inventing account access, completed verification, or policy compliance.
Do not commit signing secrets or store credentials. Define the release-key handling process before producing publication artifacts.
Separate readiness analysis, approved preparation changes, store submission, and actual publication so each step has concrete evidence and appropriate user authorization.

DEV-011 raises the Qt baseline to 6.12 and adds Qt Canvas Painter / QtCanvas2D (commercial or GPLv3; Canvas2D is technology preview). Include its distribution terms/notices and target ABI deployment in release dependency review, linked to UI-012.
acceptance_criteria: Create a publication checklist with ordered steps, dependencies, required inputs/decisions, and evidence required to finish each step.
Confirm target store/account assumptions and cite current official requirements relevant to the selected publication path.
Identify the gap between the existing debug build workflow and a reproducible signed production release.
Define readiness checks and link unresolved release blockers to their backlog tickets rather than claiming the app is ready prematurely.
List required store assets, declarations, testing/review stages, and rollout/update procedures.
Keep actual account actions, uploads, submissions, and publication outside this planning task unless separately authorized by the user.
evidence: Explicit user backlog request on 2026-10-28 to prepare and define the steps for app-store publication.

ui023_payload_observation.finding: Fresh UI-023 Android packages still contain Canvas2D and CanvasPainter libraries despite removal of explicit QML/module/link usage. Inventory the actual APK; the deployment dependency/scan path has not been established. No packaging change is included in UI-023.
